“Beautiful skin isn’t cover-model cosmetics — it’s regular, competent care that suits you. Style should do the same: quiet choices that fit your features.”

Zelko belief

# Skin claritySkin

Even tone starts with lighting and routine

If texture reads uneven, we suggest gentler cleansing and a consistent moisturizer — then re-check under the same light.

# HydrationSkin

Dehydration shows up as dull mid-face zones

Reports flag low-clarity regions and pair them with low-effort care steps, never a diagnosis.

# Natural texture

# Color matchClothing

Clothes that flatter your undertone

From your scan we suggest a short palette — cool neutrals, warm earth, or soft contrast — so outfits support the face, not fight it.

# SilhouetteClothing

Neckline and structure for your proportions

Open necklines, clean shoulders, or softer collars — ranked by effort so style changes feel doable this week.

The loop

Assess → Act → Prove

01

Assess

Upload 3–5 clear photos. Photo quality gates the pipeline first — then we measure only traits with a real signal.

02

Act

Every weak score unlocks paired recommendations ranked by effort and confidence. No low score without a next step.

03

Prove

Re-upload over time. We check lighting and angle consistency before comparing — so change isn’t a photo artifact.
